scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@planning/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev --workspace=@planning/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@planning/backend && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@planning/backend && npm run test --workspace=@planning/backend && npm run test --workspace=@planning/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=@planning/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@planning/backend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.test:database: npm run build:contracts && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@planning/backend && npm run test:database --workspace=@planning/backend
scripts.verify:ci: npm run verify && playwright test && tsx apps/backend/test/check-cleanup.ts
scripts.seed:synthetic: npm run prisma:generate --workspace=@planning/backend && npm run seed:synthetic --workspace=@planning/backend
